en: Black‑and‑white/sepia postcard view of a quiet street with cobblestones, lined by two- and three‑story residential or civic buildings. In the center foreground is a fenced stone platform or small monument area with trees and low railings. The scene looks like a small-town square or junction. Printed German text appears in red at the bottom margin, including a place name and publisher information.
